stories.title: Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk is building a factory to make turbine blades faster so he can use gas power sooner, but gas turbines create pollution and have caused legal problems in other places.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't directly affect you unless you live near where these turbines are built — it's mainly a business and environmental policy issue for governments to decide.

stories.title: AI’s worst disasters will arrive unannounced | Letters
stories.simple_summary: The headline suggests AI could cause serious problems that people won't see coming, but there's not enough detail to explain what specific problems the writer means.
stories.why_it_matters: Hard to say without more details, but the general idea is to stay alert about how AI changes things around you.

stories.title: In a rare moment of unity, Americans are fighting Big Tech together
stories.simple_summary: Americans from different political groups are working together against large technology companies, which is unusual.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and policy makers — average people should just know that concern about Big Tech is growing.

stories.title: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
stories.simple_summary: Texas stopped spending money on Flock's AI cameras that track and identify vehicles, after the state spent over $30 million on them and people complained about privacy concerns.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in Texas, this means fewer cameras watching your car movements — the state decided privacy concerns were too important.

stories.title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
stories.simple_summary: Caterpillar, the heavy equipment company, is using what it learned from running self-driving machines in mines to help it set up AI systems in other ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing changes for ordinary people or small businesses.

stories.title: America mobilises 3 powerful tech giants to Africa’s second-richest economy to counter China’s Huawei bid to build 2,008-chip AI data centre
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. is sending three major tech companies to Africa to compete against a Chinese company trying to build a giant AI computer center there.
stories.why_it_matters: This is geopolitical business — it doesn't affect you unless you work in tech or Africa.

stories.title: Micron vs. Sandisk: 1 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Memory Stock Is Clearly the Better Buy Today
stories.simple_summary: An investment writer is saying one computer memory company is a better buy than another for investors who want AI stocks.
stories.why_it_matters: This only matters if you're investing in the stock market — nothing to do with your daily life.

stories.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller Sold Broadcom and Bought These Artificial Intelligence (AI) Giants Instead
stories.simple_summary: A wealthy investor sold shares in one tech company and bought shares in different AI companies instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This is investment news that only matters if you own stocks in those companies.

stories.title: As That Whole 'Tilly Norwood' Thing Peters Out, AI Acting Achieves Unsettling Ubiquity on Chinese Phone Screens
stories.simple_summary: AI is becoming common in China for creating fake actors and performances on phones, and people are getting used to seeing it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Chinese apps or services, you might start seeing AI-created people more often — but this is mostly happening in China.

stories.title: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a “brazen campaign” of intellectual property theft
stories.simple_summary: Sony Music and Warner are suing Anthropic (an AI company) for using copyrighted songs and music without permission to train their AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a musician or songwriter, this matters — the court will decide if AI companies have to pay for the music they use to train their systems.

stories.title: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
stories.simple_summary: Two major music publishing companies are suing Anthropic because the AI company used tens of thousands of copyrighted songs to train its systems without paying for them.
stories.why_it_matters: If you write or publish music, this lawsuit could affect whether you get paid when AI companies use your work.

stories.title: “We’re not doing 30 bets a year”: Vijay Pande on betting small after running $4 billion at a16z
stories.simple_summary: A scientist who used to manage a large investment fund for biology research started a smaller AI-focused fund, and believes AI will help medicine become more like engineering (with predictable rules) instead of pure discovery.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to investors and future medical researchers — eventually AI might help doctors treat diseases more reliably, but that's years away.
